engine_cast_suspected_reason: TensorRT converted ONNX input dtype(s) to engine dtype(s), but runtime feeds used original dtype(s): pairwise_t_matrix. Binding buffers with the engine dtype makes ORT and TRT align, so this is a runtime dtype binding bug, not a plugin issue.
